In {wiki:Newhaven|Newhaven}, a cave-in has revealed a new area above the {wiki:Corrupted Mines|Corrupted Mines}. Go up with the rope, cross the poisonous gas wall and the cave to the very end, and search the body of a human to get a {item:Legion Helmet}.
A cave-in revealed one more section above the mines.
Having completed the **Protect the Village** mission from the NPC {npc:Gustavo, The Guard}.
Having completed the **Lost Wisdom** mission from the NPC {npc:Viola}.
optional, to mark the way in the cave
The rope spot is hard to see: look for it carefully.
You can drop gold coins on the ground to mark the way inside the cave so you do not get lost.
Going up to the Corrupted Mines
Go to the **northeast** tip of Newhaven and climb the stairs ({coord:32598,32418,7}) to the second floor of the {wiki:Corrupted Mines|Corrupted Mines}.
Going up through the rope spot
From there go **southwest** and climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope} (or {spell:Magic Rope}).
The rope spot is hard to see, look for it carefully.
After going up, head **east** until you reach the {item:Poison Gas} wall and cross it. Follow the route in the picture to the **east** end of the cave (the coins in the picture mark the way).
Route through the cave: the gold coins mark the way to the far east

You may find {creature:Corrupted Ghost|Corrupted Ghosts}, {creature:Corrupted Skeleton|Corrupted Skeletons}, {creature:Muglex Clan Assassin|Muglex Clan Assassins}, {creature:Muglex Clan Footman|Muglex Clan Footmen} and {creature:The Corruptor}.
At the end of the cave, use the {item:Dead Human|human corpse} to receive the reward.
After picking up the helmet, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} next to it: it takes you back to the far **west** of the cave.

From the far west of the cave, go back the same way: go down through the rope spot hole you came up by (you do not need a rope to go down), head **northeast** on the second floor of the {wiki:Corrupted Mines|Corrupted Mines} and go down the stairs to the northeast of **Newhaven**.
